purpose: Test one coefficient-free causal phase guard on failed V115: preserve the frozen 50-frame shock latch, but allow its complete-interference-certified substitutions only while the current first-seen arrival block is non-decreasing relative to the immediately preceding equal block.

mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.v115_failures: Spike throughput and both QPR direction gates failed; pulse both QPR direction gates failed. Sustained passed all three gates and pulse throughput passed.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.v115_supported_effects: Sustained throughput/QPR improved 5.206%/20.457%; pulse throughput improved 1.224%; mean QPR improved 1.015% in spike and 13.576% in pulse.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.causal_phase_evidence: V115 accepted 172 complete alternative windows. Reconstructing the two adjacent disjoint 20-frame blocks already contained in its frozen 80+20 first-seen history shows 127 accepted windows with current_count >= previous_count and 45 with current_count < previous_count. The latter continue placement changes during a causally observable decline because the 50-frame activation latch remains active.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.independent_axis: Keep the latch and every V115 placement/certificate rule, but fail closed to the exact anchor whenever the current frozen 20-frame first-seen block is smaller than the immediately preceding disjoint 20-frame block. No result-derived threshold, scenario interval, coefficient, ratio, cap, or horizon is introduced.

frozen_parent_profiles.temporal_and_service_certificate: 50-frame 3/2 causal activation with maximum candidate-to-anchor admitted-work service proxy ratio 9/10

closed_axes.causal_horizon_refitting: 25 and 50 tested in V109; V116 fixes 50 bit-for-bit
closed_axes.critical_service_ratio_refitting: 9/10 and 4/5 tested in V108; V116 fixes 9/10
closed_axes.arrival_rate_threshold_refitting: 3/2 and 2/1 tested in V107; V116 fixes 3/2
closed_axes.phase_margin_or_smoothing: forbidden; exact integer current_count >= previous_count only

hypothesis.primary: The frozen shock latch is useful for keeping a sustained overload response active, but it can outlive the causal rising phase. Placement substitutions made after first-seen arrivals begin declining perturb service during recovery and reduce paired-seed stability.
hypothesis.candidate: When the V115 latch is active, compare the current 20 frames of first-seen ReqId counts to the immediately preceding disjoint 20 frames from the same already-frozen history. Evaluate V115 only when current_count >= previous_count; otherwise dispatch the exact anchor.
hypothesis.falsification: The hypothesis fails if the sole candidate does not pass every paired throughput and both QPR gates in all three E3 scenarios on the complete fresh E917-E919 cohort.

allowed: the frozen V109 first-seen ReqId history, 3/2 shock certificate, and 50-frame activation deadline
the exact integer sum of first-seen requests in the current frozen 20-frame block
the exact integer sum of first-seen requests in the immediately preceding disjoint 20-frame block, which is the final 20 frames of the frozen 80-frame baseline
all immutable and current-state V115 admitted-work, interference, locality, resource, routed-score, OCS, welfare, feasibility, and critical-frontier inputs
forbidden: completion count, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, SLA outcome, or any completed-request aggregate
future arrivals, future completion, future container state, or future child placement
workload scenario, burst label, seed identity, registered burst interval, or time-to-burst-boundary
E899-E916 result-dependent threshold, ratio, horizon, coefficient, cap, smoothing width, or scenario refitting
confirmation-seed outcomes before a training pass
information_boundary.phase_definition: With a complete contiguous frozen 100-frame history, previous_count is the sum over baseline entries 60..79 and current_count is the sum over recent entries 80..99. The phase is eligible iff current_count >= previous_count using exact non-overflowing integer arithmetic.
information_boundary.arrival_and_activation_definition: Bit-for-bit V109 horizon50: 80-frame baseline, 20-frame recent first-seen ReqId history, at least 20 requests in each, exact 3/2 integer comparison, deadline current_frame+49.
information_boundary.candidate_service_proxy: Bit-for-bit V115 admitted-work service proxy and complete interference certificate.
information_boundary.fail_closed: Incomplete/noncontiguous history, arithmetic overflow, missing current-state input, or any failed V115 certificate preserves the exact anchor assignment.

candidate_mechanism.only_changed_axis: Add the exact adjacent-equal-window non-decreasing first-seen arrival phase guard before V115 alternative construction; retain every V115 candidate choice and complete certificate bit-for-bit.
candidate_mechanism.reference_policy: Policy-independent offline reference construction remains unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.exact_anchor_invariant: Without a complete contiguous phase history, a non-decreasing phase, an active frozen latch, complete current-state inputs, or all V115 certificates, dispatch exact V94 for identical state and candidates.

per_window: all frozen V115 causal-arrival, admitted-work, critical-service, and complete-interference fields
arrival_phase_gate_enabled, history_complete, previous_count, current_count, non_decreasing, and exact block size 20
performance fields retained but not opened before joint blind audit

selection_rule.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.E3_winner_requires: the sole candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection_rule.absolute_formal_n20_baseline_gates: diagnostic only and never used to select the V116 profile
